title: Slow-tier statistical escapability/fairness sweep for competitive mechanics (1000+ seeds)
description: Filed from TASK-058 review (rev-t058 L1). Each competitive mechanic's per-ticket escapability test uses ~20 seeds/pattern (a legitimate 'set de test' per GDD §4 for the mechanic ticket). GDD §ring-1 (line ~849) envisions a much larger 1000+ seed statistical sweep as a fairness gate. This ticket adds that broader sweep as a SLOW-tier / opt-in test run (kept out of the fast suite so it doesn't slow the TDD inner loop) covering the competitive mechanics as they land: MECH_02 ESQUIVA (TASK-058, done — escapability solver bot exists), and MECH_01 MANTÉN (TASK-060) + MECH_03 CORRE (TASK-059) + the asymmetric mechanics (TASK-040) as those close. Reuse each mechanic's existing solver/optimal-play oracle; assert the fairness property (optimal play survives / no forced loss) holds across the large seed set; surface any failing seed for design review. Gate it behind a slow-tier category/trait or a separate test project so CI's fast leg stays fast (coordinate with TASK-049's CI — the slow sweep could be a separate scheduled workflow, not per-push).
acceptance_criteria: A slow-tier statistical escapability sweep (1000+ seeds per pattern/mechanic) runs each competitive mechanic's optimal-play oracle and asserts the GDD fairness property across the set, kept OUT of the fast suite.
MECH_02 is covered first (its solver bot already exists); MECH_01/MECH_03/asymmetric mechanics are added as their tickets close, or a follow-up notes the deferral explicitly.
Any failing seed is surfaced (logged, not silently skipped) for design review rather than auto-passing.
The sweep is invokable on demand and/or via a scheduled CI workflow separate from the per-push fast leg (coordinate with TASK-049).

CLOSED (loop mode, auto_close_on_green_review). rev-t063 fresh-context review of d01dce6..58a2ef5 → APPROVE-WITH-NITS, 0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM / 4 LOW + 1 human design-gate. Depth FULL.

COMMITS: eb7a341 (test: slow sweep) + 58a2ef5 (ci: slow-sweep.yml). Purely ADDITIVE (756 insertions, 0 deletions): separate project slow-tests/Barcade.Core.SlowTests (SDK-style, links the shipped Core sims via glob, no Unity) + Oracles/ (verbatim-copied solvers) + slow-sweep.yml + README + .gitignore. STRUCTURALLY cannot leak into the fast leg.

AC VERDICTS (all MET): AC1 SweepSeeds=1000 plain loops, no [TestCase] reduction/early-break, separate project. AC2 all 3 mechanics (ESQUIVA+MANTÉN+CORRE); asymmetric TASK-040 deferral noted. AC3 collect-all-then-Assert.Is.Empty, no swallow/fail-fast, seed+pattern+property+tick logged. AC4 workflow_dispatch + weekly schedule (cron 0 6 * * 1), NOT push/PR.

ORACLE FIDELITY (deepest check) — reviewer diffed each vs its fast original: ALL THREE are BYTE-VERBATIM copies of the validated fast-suite solvers (EsquivaEscapeBot=EscapeBot, MantenCorrectionOracle=CorrectionOracle, CorrePerfectRunner=PerfectRunner), same constants, PUBLIC RenderState/accessors only (no private-state peek), NOT weakened. NON-VACUOUS: MANTÉN has a null-input falls-by-default dual (strongest); CORRE is fast-suite mutation-anchored; ESQUIVA rests on argument (the same bot IS eliminable at 7-8s → 5s survival is earned) — the one thin spot → LOW-1. Seed counts all ≥1000: ESQUIVA 1000×4 patterns, MANTÉN 1000×4 survive + 1000×4 null, CORRE 1000×4 + 1000 non-inversion.

5s-vs-8s CRUX RULING (reviewer): (a) LEGITIMATE, NOT goalpost-moving — 5s is the LONGEST shipped duration (EsquivaParams.GddDefaults=5.0; mg_esquiva assets ramp DOWN d1=5/d2=4/d3=3; the 8s failures at ticks 404-472 are physically unreachable in any shipped round). (b) 5s pass is MEANINGFUL/non-vacuous (full-strength verbatim oracle, demonstrably eliminable at longer durations). (c) SURFACE + TICKET the longer-ESQUIVA concern → done.

4 LOW nits + the human DESIGN GATE routed to FOLLOW-UP TASK-067: LOW-1 (add ESQUIVA non-vacuity dual), LOW-2 (sweep the turn-cap-only hard regime at scale), LOW-3 (assert all 4 seats not Rojo-only), LOW-4 (logger-independent full failing-seed tail); + HUMAN DESIGN GATE: before shipping any ESQUIVA baseDuration>6, verify escape-EXISTENCE via a multi-ply solver (not just reactive survival) OR cap duration <=6s in the validator — protects the GDD 'siempre existe escape' guarantee (carries the 6 HomingSoft regression seeds). Reviewer's optional mutation (rerun ESQUIVA at 8s to evidence the surfacing path on a real failure) folded into TASK-067. 5th ticket closed this run.
